_comment: Editorial content for ASLPS, which is a listed security of another issuer rather than an operating company — see description and sourceNote. No image is attached: a security line owns no facility, and a photograph of the issuer's plant would misrepresent it as a separate business.
description: Aisha Steel Convertible (Pref) is a separate listed security issued by Aisha Steel Mills Limited — the company's convertible preference shares — traded on the Pakistan Stock Exchange alongside its ordinary shares (ASL) under the symbol ASLPS. PSX publishes no separate company profile for this line; the issuer's business is described under ASL.
sourceNote: PSX instrument listing for ASLPS (dps.psx.com.pk/company/ASLPS: symbol name and equity profile; no company profile published) and the issuer's own website (aishasteel.com), read 2026-10-17.
